subject: english
stem: This recorded notice was shared this morning. Which detail is stated in the message?
options: the blue bottle claim has no test method or source
the small bottle claim has a source but no test conditions
the small bottle claim has no test method or source
the small bottle claim names one test method but no source

optionRationales.reason: the blue bottle claim has no test method or source：此項把「small」改成「blue」。音稿明確陳述「the small bottle claim has no test method or source」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the small bottle claim has no test method or source」。

the small bottle claim has a source but no test conditions：此項把「no test method or source」改成「a source but no test conditions」。音稿明確陳述「the small bottle claim has no test method or source」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the small bottle claim has no test method or source」。
the small bottle claim has no test method or source：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。音稿明確陳述「the small bottle claim has no test method or source」。

the small bottle claim names one test method but no source：此項把「has no test method or」改成「names one test method but no」。音稿明確陳述「the small bottle claim has no test method or source」。因此，鎖定證據支持「the small bottle claim has no test method or source」。
